title: OpenCGMES Configuration (opencgmes.jsonc)
description: Configuration for OpenCGMES tools. CIMVocabCheck reads the "cimvocabcheck" section. Place this file at the root of your project (or any parent directory of your queries); CIMVocabCheck discovers the nearest one walking up the tree. The file is optional — but without a configured schema, validation is syntax-only (there is no bundled default schema).

cimnotebook.description: CIM Notebook execution settings (VS Code). Named connections referenced by # [endpoint=<name>] directives, plus workspace defaults for running cells. Passwords are NEVER stored here — declare "authType": "basic" and CIMNotebook keeps the credentials in VS Code secret storage.

connections.description: Named SPARQL endpoint connections for notebook cells.

name.description: The connection's name — cells reference it with # [endpoint=<name>]. Use letters, digits, dashes and underscores (no dots or slashes, which would read as a file path).

url.description: SPARQL query endpoint URL, e.g. http://localhost:3030/dataset/query.

updateUrl.description: SPARQL Update endpoint URL. Omit to derive it from "url" (Fuseki-style …/query → …/update).

shaclUrl.description: SHACL validation service URL. Omit to derive it from "url" (…/query → …/shacl?graph=default).

authType.description: Authentication scheme. With "basic", CIMNotebook prompts once for username/password and stores them in VS Code secret storage — never in this file.

default.description: Cells without a # [endpoint=...] directive run against this connection.

queryTimeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout for notebook cell executions, in seconds (built-in default: 30).

maxRows.description: Default cap on returned rows/triples per execution (built-in default: 10000).

cimvocabcheck.description: CIMVocabCheck SPARQL/SHACL validation settings. All fields are optional; when neither "schemas" nor "schemasDirectory" is set, no schema is loaded and validation is syntax-only (there is no bundled default schema).

schemasDirectory.description: Path to a directory containing RDFS profile files (.rdf, .ttl, .owl). All files in the directory are loaded as schema profiles. Path is resolved relative to this config file. Without this (and without "schemas"), validation is syntax-only.

schemas.description: List of individual RDFS profile files to load. Each entry is a path relative to this config file. Without this (and without "schemasDirectory"), validation is syntax-only.

items.description: Path to an RDFS profile file (.rdf, .ttl, or .owl), relative to this config file.

namedGraphs.description: Maps named graph IRIs (or short relative names like "EQ") to one or more profile version IRIs. When set, terms inside a GRAPH <iri> {} block are validated against the mapped profiles only instead of all profiles. Graphs referenced in the query but absent from the map produce a GRAPH_NOT_CONFIGURED warning.

additionalProperties.description: One or more profile version IRIs for this graph.

strictness.description:
Controls which findings are reported and how their severities are mapped.

• permissive — only unknown-term and syntax errors; semantic checks and hints are suppressed. Good for exploratory queries against an incomplete schema.
• default — all checks, original severities. Only errors fail validation.
• strict — all checks; warnings are promoted to errors. Recommended for CI.
• pedantic — all checks; warnings and hints are promoted to errors.

prefixes.description: Custom default PREFIX declarations injected into every SPARQL query that does not already declare them. Omit this field to use the built-in defaults (rdf, rdfs, owl, xsd, sh, cim, md). Set to {} to disable all default prefixes. Provide an explicit map to replace the built-in defaults entirely.

additionalProperties.description: Namespace IRI for this prefix, e.g. "http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100#"

standardVocabulary.description:
Controls checking of terms in the closed standard vocabularies (rdf, rdfs, owl, sh).

• check — terms are validated against the official vocabularies, so typos like rdf:typ or sh:minCountt are reported as UNKNOWN_VOCABULARY_TERM errors (default).
• ignore — terms in these namespaces are accepted without inspection (legacy behaviour).

Open annotation/datatype namespaces (xsd, dcterms, skos, …) are always accepted regardless of this setting.

rules.description:
Overrides the severity of individual checks, keyed by validation code (for example PROPERTY_MAY_BE_ABSENT or DATATYPE_MISMATCH).

A code listed here keeps the configured severity regardless of "strictness" — it is neither promoted by "strict"/"pedantic" nor filtered out by "permissive".

additionalProperties.description:
Severity for this check.

• off — never report it.
• info — report as a hint.
• warn — report as a warning.
• error — report as an error (fails validation).

cimNamespaces.description: Maps custom CIM namespace URIs to the built-in profile "shape" that matches their ontology conventions, so schema files/endpoint graphs using them can be parsed. Use this when a profile declares its terms under a namespace other than the standard http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100# (or CIM version-specific equivalents).

additionalProperties.description:
Profile shape to use for this namespace.

• cim16 — legacy CGMES 2.4.15 style: cims:isFixed-based version IRIs.
• cim17 — CGMES 3.0+ style: owl:versionIRI, dcat:keyword.
• cim18 — like cim17, plus CIM18's DocumentHeader-based metadata.
